We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: AWS Cloud Sales Operations Executive
description:
1. Job Purpose

The AWS Cloud Sales Operations Executive will manage end-to-end AWS sales operations, customer billing coordination, distributor engagement, margin tracking, discount approvals, payment collection follow-ups, and operational reporting. The primary objective is to ensure accurate and timely billing, maximize AWS commercial margins, reduce revenue leakage, improve collections, maintain customer satisfaction, and support the profitable growth of Enreap's AWS cloud business. The candidate will work closely with AWS distributors such as Crayon, AWS Alliance, Sales, Finance, Presales, Technical, and Customer Success teams.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. AWS Billing and Account Operations

* Coordinate AWS customer billing, monthly invoice generation, verification, and timely invoice submission.
* Maintain customer-wise AWS account IDs, billing details, monthly consumption, invoice references, and payment terms.
* Reconcile distributor invoices, AWS billing reports, customer invoices, credit notes, and adjustments.
* Identify billing discrepancies, incorrect charges, missing credits, and revenue leakage.
* Track AWS account transfers, billing ownership changes, and distributor-related operational requests.
* Maintain accurate records of customer billing arrangements, discount approvals, and commercial terms.

B. Distributor and AWS Alliance Coordination

* Act as the primary operational contact for Crayon and other approved AWS distributors.
* Follow up on AWS billing, distributor margins, credit notes, special pricing, payment adjustments, and account-level issues.
* Coordinate approved customer discount requests and maintain a record of approval validity and commercial conditions.
* Escalate delayed approvals, unprocessed credits, and commercial discrepancies to the AWS Alliance Head.

C. AWS Margin and Profitability Management

* Maintain a customer-wise AWS revenue, distributor cost, discount, credit adjustment, and gross margin tracker.
* Calculate customer-level gross profit and gross margin percentage using approved cost and revenue data.
* Identify low-margin, zero-margin, or loss-making AWS accounts and highlight corrective actions.
* Verify commercial profitability before Sales submits quotations or commits customer discounts.
* Track discount utilization, distributor rebates, and approved pricing benefits.
* Recommend opportunities to improve margins through better pricing, billing arrangements, and approved distributor commercial terms.

D. AWS Payment Collections and Outstanding Management

* Maintain a daily tracker of customer invoices, due dates, amounts collected, and outstanding balances.
* Send payment reminders before and after invoice due dates.
* Share a weekly customer-wise outstanding report with Sales leadership and Finance.
* Follow up with customers on overdue invoices and obtain payment commitments.
* Coordinate payment reconciliation, remittance advice, UTR details, and allocation of receipts with Finance.
* Escalate overdue payments, repeated payment delays, and high-risk accounts promptly.
* Track receivable ageing buckets: 0–30, 31–60, 61–90, and over 90 days.
* Support approved credit-control, billing-transfer, and account-handover processes in coordination with Finance, Sales, and Technical teams.

E. Customer Relationship and Retention

* Respond to customer queries related to AWS invoices, billing, discounts, and account-level commercial information.
* Explain approved billing arrangements and applicable discounts in clear, professional language.
* Coordinate billing disputes and service-related escalations with the appropriate internal teams.
* Maintain customer communication records and follow up until issues are resolved.
* Identify customers at risk because of billing disputes, payment delays, or dissatisfaction and escalate them to the reporting manager.
* Support renewal discussions, customer retention, and expansion opportunities by providing accurate billing and consumption information.

F. AWS Sales Operations Support

* Support the AWS Sales team with quotations, commercial calculations, discount approvals, and profitability checks.
* Maintain an opportunity tracker covering customer name, AWS opportunity ID, stage, estimated monthly recurring revenue, expected margin, and next action.
* Coordinate internal approvals for special pricing, customer proposals, and billing arrangements.
* Support AWS partner opportunity registration and maintain required operational records in ACE/PRM or other applicable partner systems.
* Track customer onboarding, billing activation, account transfer, and handover milestones.
* Help Sales identify expansion opportunities through billing trends, customer consumption growth, and renewal dates.

G. Reporting and Process Improvement

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly AWS operations dashboards.
* Publish monthly customer-wise revenue, cost, gross profit, gross margin, and overdue receivables reports.
* Maintain a centralized tracker for invoices, payment commitments, discounts, credit notes, and distributor escalations.
* Improve reporting accuracy using Excel, pivot tables, lookup formulas, and Power Query.
* Identify repetitive manual work suitable for automation using approved reporting tools and workflows.
* Maintain documentation and audit trails for commercial approvals, invoices, collections, and distributor communications.

H. Internal Coordination and Compliance

* Coordinate with Sales, Finance, AWS Alliance, Presales, Technical, and Customer Success teams.
* Ensure customer commercial commitments align with approved pricing and payment terms.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer billing information and commercial agreements.
* Follow Enreap's credit-control, approval, invoicing, and customer communication policies.
* Escalate material billing risks, potential losses, and overdue collections to management without delay.

**Commercial principle:**
No customer discount, pricing exception, or margin commitment should be finalized without the required internal approval.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

**KPI**

**Suggested Target**

Invoice submission

98% or more within the agreed internal timeline

Billing accuracy

At least 99.5%

Billing reconciliation

100% of active customer accounts reconciled monthly

Customer billing queries

Acknowledge within 4 business hours; resolve routine queries within 2 business days

Outstanding report

Updated weekly with 100% of known overdue invoices included

Payment follow-up

100% of overdue invoices followed up according to the collection schedule

Collections

Achieve at least 95% of the agreed monthly collection target, with a stretch goal of 100%

Margin visibility

100% of active accounts have a monthly revenue, cost, and margin record

Commercial approvals

100% of discounts and pricing exceptions supported by required approval

Distributor issue resolution

At least 90% of routine operational issues resolved within the agreed SLA

Reporting

100% of scheduled weekly and monthly reports submitted on time

**Note:**
Targets should be calibrated to Enreap's existing systems, customer portfolio, and baseline performance during the first 30 days.

4. Required Skills and Qualifications

Education and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, IT, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in cloud sales operations, AWS billing, distributor coordination, commercial operations, or financial operations.
* Experience working with a cloud reseller, managed service provider, IT services company, or cloud distributor is preferred.

AWS and Commercial Knowledge

* Working knowledge of AWS billing, AWS Pricing Calculator, AWS Cost Explorer, and AWS invoices.
* Understanding of AWS partner/distributor billing and discount structures.
* Familiarity with AWS CloudFront pricing, data transfer charges, and applicable discount mechanisms.
* Understanding of monthly recurring revenue, gross profit, gross margin, receivables, and revenue reconciliation.
* Awareness of AWS partner programs and ACE/PRM is an advantage.

Technical and Analytical Skills

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, and data reconciliation.
* Ability to prepare customer-wise financial trackers and management dashboards.
* Familiarity with Power Query, Power BI, or workflow automation is desirable.
* Ability to understand AWS account structures, billing reports, and basic cloud terminology.

Communication and Behavioural Skills

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Professional customer follow-up and payment collection capabilities.
* Attention to detail and ownership of assigned tasks.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple teams and external distributors.
* Commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and timely escalation of risks.

5. First 90-Day Expectations

First 30 days — Establish control

* Build a verified tracker of active AWS customers, account IDs, invoices, payment terms, discounts, and margins.
* Identify overdue invoices, unresolved billing disputes, missing credits, and accounts with unclear profitability.
* Document the monthly billing and collection process.

Days 31–60 — Improve control and collections

* Implement a standard weekly outstanding report and payment follow-up schedule.
* Reconcile distributor costs against customer billing.
* Flag low-margin and loss-making accounts.
* Establish a tracker for distributor credits and pending approvals.

Days 61–90 — Improve profitability and efficiency

* Deliver a monthly customer profitability dashboard.
* Recommend actionable margin improvements and reductions in revenue leakage.
* Improve collection visibility and reduce avoidable billing delays.
* Automate suitable recurring reports and establish a measurable operations review process.

6. Authority and Approval Boundaries

The executive is responsible for preparing analyses, coordinating approvals, maintaining records, and following up on agreed actions. The executive cannot independently approve customer discounts, change contractual payment terms, commit distributor rebates, waive outstanding amounts, suspend production services, or make representations about data deletion or recovery. Such actions must follow Enreap's authorization matrix and applicable customer agreements and AWS policies.

7. Why Join Enreap?

* Work with an AWS Advanced Tier Services Partner.
* Gain practical experience in cloud commercial operations, billing, alliances, and profitability management.
* Develop exposure to AWS distributor programs and cloud business reporting.
* Contribute directly to customer retention, operational efficiency, and profitable cloud business growth.

**Application:**
Candidates should share their resume highlighting AWS billing, cloud sales operations, distributor coordination, Excel reporting, and payment collection experience.

title: Lead – Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) Services
description:
**Summary:**
The Lead – Azure Virtual Desktop Services owns the end-to-end management, security, optimization, and evolution of the organization’s Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) platform, covering both single-session and multi-session environments. The role leads a team responsible for provisioning, compliance, patching, automation, cost optimization, and disaster recovery, while acting as the key point of contact for business stakeholders, the MAPS team, and security personnel.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. AVD Platform Management

* Operate and support single-session, multi-session, and persistent AVD environments.
* Manage platform configuration, provisioning, de-provisioning, applications, access, and user transitions.

B. Updates, Patching & Compliance

* Maintain current applications, images, and security patches across AVD host pools.
* Own compliance reporting, audit readiness, and remediation in line with policies and standards.

C. Security & Cross-Team Coordination

* Partner with the MAPS and security teams to maintain a secure, compliant AVD estate.
* Coordinate security reviews, vulnerability remediation, access controls, and policy enforcement.

D. Cost, Capacity & Performance Optimization

* Optimize capacity, performance, and Azure consumption through right-sizing and scaling.
* Track utilization and costs, report trends, and recommend FinOps savings initiatives.

E. Automation, Tooling & Enhancements

* Own PowerShell scripts, APIs, portals, databases, and supporting automation tools.
* Drive automation, standardization, self-service, reliability, and continuous improvement.

F. Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery

* Maintain and regularly test documented AVD disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Define and monitor RTO/RPO targets, backups, and failover strategies.

G. Stakeholder & Team Leadership

* Lead and develop the AVD team, allocate work, and ensure delivery against SLAs.
* Manage stakeholder alignment through service reviews, roadmaps, status updates, and risk communication.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Experience

* 8–12 years in IT infrastructure/end-user computing, with at least 4–5 years of hands-on experience in Azure Virtual Desktop.
* Proven experience leading or technically guiding a team in a managed-service or enterprise environment.
* Experience managing stakeholder relationships across business, security, and technical teams.

Technical Skills

* Deep expertise in Azure Virtual Desktop (host pools, session hosts, FSLogix, MSIX app attach, scaling plans, image management).
* Strong working knowledge of Azure services: Entra ID (Azure AD), networking (VNets, NSGs, peering), storage, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Azure Policy, and Defender for Cloud.
* Advanced PowerShell scripting; experience with REST APIs, Azure CLI, and Infrastructure as Code (ARM/Bicep/Terraform).
* Experience with databases and web-based admin/support portals used for automation and workflow.
* Hands-on experience with Azure cost management, right-sizing, and FinOps practices.
* Experience designing and testing DR/BCP solutions (Azure Site Recovery, Azure Backup, multi-region designs).
* Knowledge of security and compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS benchmarks).

4. Preferred Qualifications

* Microsoft certifications such as AZ-140 (Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty), AZ-104, AZ-305, or SC-300.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions).
* ITIL certification or familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Experience in large-scale or regulated enterprise environments.

Zendesk is a leader in customer experience solutions, dedicated to delivering innovative technology and exceptional service. Our Contact Center Center of Excellence (CoE) focuses on optimizing customer support platforms, including Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS-based solutions, to enhance customer interactions and operational efficiency.

We are seeking a seasoned Contact Center Partner Solutions Consultant with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX Suites—preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS—with a strong focus on partner onboarding, technical enablement, and co-selling support. This role will lead partner technical enablement efforts, ensuring partners are fully equipped and supported to resell and implement Zendesk Contact Center solutions effectively. The ideal candidate will provide strategic direction, technical leadership, and hands-on expertise to drive partner success and seamless integration of contact center solutions.
  
  
**Core Daily Activities**

* Partner Onboarding and Enablement: Drive the technical onboarding process for partners, ensuring they acquire the skills and knowledge necessary to successfully implement and resell Zendesk Contact Center solutions.

* Architect and Optimize Contact Center Solutions: Design scalable and efficient architectures leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk to support partner deployments.
* Lead Technical Strategy and Partner Roadmap: Define technical enablement strategies aligned with partner needs and evolving business goals.
* Provide Technical Leadership and Mentorship: Coach partners, internal teams, and presales specialists on best practices in solution design and deployment.

* Support Pre-Sales and Post-Sales Activities with Partners: Support technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, PoCs, and ongoing partner support.
* Develop Enablement Materials: Create technical documentation, playbooks, and training content tailored for partner consumption.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner Success Focus: Own the technical onboarding and enablement process for partners, reducing onboarding friction and accelerating time to market.
* Strategic Leadership: Define and execute the architectural vision for partner-facing contact center solutions within the CoE framework.
* Technical Oversight: Support and guide partners and internal teams to adhere to architectural best practices, security standards, and delivery excellence.
* Collaboration: Work with partner sales leads, sales, and engineering teams to align on technical requirements, scope, and co-sell strategies.
* Innovation Advocacy: Promote adoption of the latest contact center technologies and best practices with partners.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure partner solutions meet compliance, security, and governance requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Business Administration.
* Experience: Minimum of 10 years in solution architecture, with at least 5 years focused on contact center technologies including Amazon Connect and Zendesk, with partner-facing or customer enablement experience preferred.
* Technical Expertise: Proficient designing solutions using Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS services (Lambda, Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway). Experience with Python and/or NodeJS is a plus.
* Enablement Skills: Demonstrated ability to deliver technical training and enablement to partners or customers.
* Leadership: Experience leading technical engagements involving multiple stakeholders including partners, internal teams, and vendors.
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written skills with the ability to translate complex technical information for diverse audiences.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills and ability to devise creative technical solutions in partner-centric contexts.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: Zendesk certifications, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent.
* Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with omnichannel contact center solutions, AI-driven automation, workforce engagement management, and reporting tools.
* Agile Experience: Working knowledge of Agile and DevOps methodologies.

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.

This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.
  
  
**The Intelligent Heart Of Customer Experience**
Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.
  
  
Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.

description:
The Architecture Senior Analyst is a seasoned professional role. Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits. Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Analyzes system / application architecture; ensures that architecture conforms to enterprise blueprints.
* Evaluates and tests potential IT architecture solutions to ensure they meet user needs and requirements.
* Creates and produces moderately complex IT architecture designs to translate user requirements to solutions.
* Researches and produces standards documents.
* Researches future industry trends; acts as resource for development staff regarding the use of new technologies.
* Applies hardware engineering and software design theories and principles in researching, designing, and developing product hardware and software interfaces.
* Translates complex business problems into sound technical solutions.
* Exhibits sound understanding of concepts and principles in architecture and basic knowledge of these elements in other areas.
* Requires in-depth understanding of how the area integrates within architecture and has basic commercial awareness.
* Trains and mentors junior team members.
* Uses evaluative judgment based on the analysis of factual information in complicated or novel situations; uses multiple sources of information.
* Has direct impact to the architecture area by ensuring the quality of the tasks/services/ information provided by self and others.
* Exhibits sound and comprehensive communication and diplomacy skills to exchange complex information.
* Performs other job duties and functions as assigned
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

**Qualifications:**

* 8-15 years relevant experience
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
* Management and prioritization skills
* Ability to develop working relationships, manage multiple activities and changing priorities
* Ability to work under pressure and to meet tight deadlines
* Self-starter with ability to take the initiative and master new tasks quickly
* Methodical, attention to detail

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.
  
  
Couchbase Engineer - Assistant Vice President
  
  
A
**Couchbase Engineer**
is a specialized database professional responsible for designing, deploying, managing, and optimizing Couchbase Server clusters. Couchbase is a distributed, high-performance NoSQL document database that combines a flexible JSON model with a powerful SQL-like query language (N1QL) and an integrated caching layer.
  
  
To be successful, a Couchbase Engineer must possess a blend of core database administration (DBA) skills, NoSQL data modeling expertise, system performance tuning capabilities, and modern DevOps/automation skills.
  
  

* Core Couchbase Administration & Architecture
* Multi-Dimensional Scaling (MDS): Ability to design and configure clusters where specific services (Data, Query, Index, Search, Eventing, Analytics, Backup) are assigned to dedicated nodes to optimize resource utilization and prevent resource contention.
* Cross-Datacenter Replication (XDCR): Expertise in setting up, monitoring, and troubleshooting high-performance, low-latency replication across geographically distributed clusters (active-active or active-passive) for disaster recovery and localized data access.
* Cluster Operations: Proficiency in node initialization, joining nodes to existing clusters, rebalancing data across nodes, and performing rolling upgrades without downtime.
* Security & Compliance: Implementing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), configuring TLS/SSL certificates for secure node-to-node and client-to-node communication, and managing administrative secrets securely.
* Data Modeling & Query Optimization
* JSON Document Design: Designing efficient document schemas, understanding document keys, sub-documents, and choosing between referencing (normalization) and embedding (denormalization) based on access patterns.
* N1QL (SQL for NoSQL): Writing and optimizing complex queries using N1QL, understanding query execution plans (using EXPLAIN), and leveraging query parameters.
* Global Secondary Indexes (GSI): Creating and managing indexes, understanding index partitioning, and choosing the appropriate index storage engine (Standard GSI vs. Memory-Optimized GSI).
* Full-Text Search (FTS) & Analytics: Configuring search indexes for natural language queries and setting up the Analytics service for complex, ad-hoc analytical queries without impacting operational workloads.
* Performance Tuning & Sizing
* Memory Quota Allocation: Sizing and allocating RAM quotas for different services (Data, Index, Search, Eventing, Analytics) based on workload requirements.
* Eviction Policies: Understanding and configuring bucket eviction policies (Value Eviction vs. Full Eviction) and choosing between Couchbase buckets and Ephemeral buckets (in-memory only).
* Disk I/O & Storage Paths: Configuring custom disk paths for data, indexes, eventing, and analytics to optimize disk write queues and read performance.
* Operating System Tuning: Configuring Linux system limits (ulimits), such as soft/hard user processes and soft/hard open files, to handle high concurrent connections and file descriptors.
* DevOps, Automation & Infrastructure (Enterprise Context)

Modern enterprise environments require Couchbase Engineers to automate database lifecycles:
  
  

* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Ansible:

+ Automating Couchbase installation, cluster initialization, node management, bucket creation, user provisioning, backups, and upgrades.
+ Familiarity with Ansible catalog roles such as couchbase\_install, couchbase\_cluster, couchbase\_node, couchbase\_rebalance, couchbase\_bucket, couchbase\_user, couchbase\_backup, couchbase\_upgrade, and couchbase\_upload\_logs.
+ Managing hosts inventories and group variables (e.g., hosts.yaml, all.yaml, cb\_cluster.yaml) to define cluster topologies and service allocations.

* Containerization & Orchestration: Deploying and managing Couchbase on Kubernetes or Red Hat OpenShift using the Couchbase Autonomous Operator (CAO).
* Linux Administration: Strong command of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7/8), including package management, systemd service configuration, network troubleshooting, and log analysis.
* General NoSQL & Distributed Systems Concepts
* CAP Theorem: Understanding the trade-offs between Consistency, Availability, and Partition Tolerance in distributed databases.
* Consistency Models: Configuring write durability and read consistency levels (e.g., eventual consistency vs. strong consistency).
* ACID Transactions: Implementing multi-document ACID transactions in Couchbase when strong transactional guarantees are required.

title: Sr. Enterprise Architect
description:
Enterprise Architect — IT Infrastructure Specialisation

Purpose of the Role

Fluidra's Enterprise Architecture function ensures alignment between business and IT strategy, taking a global, enterprise-wide perspective across business processes, information, applications and technology. The Enterprise Architect ensures enterprise goals are addressed holistically across all IT and Transformation Office projects, from design through deployment into production.

Working within the EA Organization under the Enterprise Architecture Lead, the Enterprise Architect defines target architectures for portfolio initiatives, guides project and solution teams, and safeguards architectural integrity across the five EASC domains: Process & Applications, Data, Security, Integration and Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

* **Target architecture design:**
  Define the target Enterprise Architecture for portfolio initiatives across the five EASC domains — business process and application, data model, security, integration and infrastructure — working with Domain Architects and Tech Vertical (Solution) Architects.
* **Project governance:**
  Lead the initial EASC assessment as the mandatory architecture contact at the PPM G2 (Readiness) gate, drive the solution through to EASC sign-off at G3 (Execution Start), and re-assess at G5 (Go-Live/Hypercare) where structural changes occur.
* **Architecture deliverables:**
  Produce architecture assessments, executive summaries and diagrams covering application, data, integration and infrastructure views.
* **Repository management:**
  Create and maintain architecture objects in LeanIX (Initiatives, Applications, IT Components, Interfaces, Business Contexts, Organizations, Platforms, Providers) in line with the EASC lifecycle and ownership model.
* **Committee participation:**
  Act as a permanent EASC representative — prepare and present proposals at the biweekly committee meeting, evaluate initiatives against the EA principles, and contribute to draft and final assessments within the planning cycle.
* **Principle-based assessment:**
  Apply Fluidra's eight EA principles as the standing evaluation lens, with explicit attention to business value, buy/rent-vs-build, technical debt, simplicity and modularity, and the SaaS → PaaS → IaaS deployment hierarchy (AWS as IaaS provider).
* **Stakeholder engagement:**
  Partner with the IT Leadership Team, project/delivery teams and business stakeholders to ensure architecture decisions are understood, adopted and traceable.
* **Gap identification:**
  Identify enterprise technology capability gaps, propose solutions, and contribute to the continuous improvement of EASC process and documentation.

Required Experience & Skills

* 10+ years of IT experience, including 5+ years in enterprise or solution architecture roles.
* Proven experience as an Enterprise or Solution Architect across multiple architecture domains: business process and application, data, security, integration and infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of an EA framework (TOGAF or equivalent); ability to operate within a tailored, in-house methodology rather than a textbook standard.
* Hands-on experience with an EA repository tool — LeanIX strongly preferred.
* Solid understanding of cloud strategy and the SaaS → PaaS → IaaS hierarchy, with practical exposure to AWS.
* Familiarity with enterprise application landscapes spanning ERP, integration and CRM ecosystems.
* Strong analytical and modelling skills, with the ability to produce clear architecture diagrams and concise, executive-level assessments.
* Excellent written and spoken English; confident communicating with C-suite, IT leadership and delivery teams across geographies.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with SAP (S/4HANA, BTP) and Salesforce landscapes.
* Exposure to API-first, event-enabled and integration-centric architecture patterns.
* Awareness of data governance, master data and single-source-of-truth principles.
* TOGAF certification or equivalent EA credential.
* Experience operating within a stage-gated PPM governance model.

Location & Working Model

Based in Pune, India, as part of Fluidra's global Enterprise Architecture and IT team. The role requires collaboration across time zones with EASC leadership and colleagues in Europe and Americas, including availability for the biweekly EASC meeting held Tuesday afternoons (CEST).

title: Senior Infrastructure / Cloud Engineer
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
  
  
**Job Details**
**About The Role**
CBS is seeking a
**Senior Infrastructure/Cloud Engineer**
to lead the design, automation, and security of our hybrid infrastructure landscape. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep technical expertise across systems administration, networking, Infrastructure-as-Code, container orchestration, and Azure cloud, combined with the ability to mentor junior engineers, drive architectural decisions, and own critical infrastructure and security initiatives end-to-end.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the architecture, administration, and hardening of Linux and Windows server environments across the organization.
* Design and govern network security architecture — firewalls, forward/reverse proxies, DMZ zones — ensuring alignment with enterprise security standards.
* Lead the development of Infrastructure-as-Code standards and reusable Terraform modules for scalable, repeatable provisioning.
* Architect and build advanced Python-based automation frameworks to reduce manual operations and improve reliability.
* Drive deployment strategy and lifecycle management for applications across environments, ensuring high availability and performance.
* Lead design, scaling, and troubleshooting of Kubernetes clusters in production environments, including capacity planning and incident response.
* Own administration and governance of container registries (Harbor) — including image lifecycle policies, RBAC, and integration with vulnerability scanning pipelines.
* Architect and manage Microsoft Azure infrastructure (networking, compute, storage, identity) with a focus on scalability, cost optimization, and security.
* Lead vulnerability remediation initiatives across the estate — including OS kernel patching and Java JDK version/patch management — establishing proactive patch management processes.
* Drive root-cause analysis for critical infrastructure incidents and lead post-incident reviews.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level engineers.
* Partner with security, application, and DevOps teams to define infrastructure standards, compliance posture, and best practices.
* Evaluate new tools/technologies and make recommendations to improve infrastructure maturity.
* Create and maintain high-quality documentation, architecture diagrams, and runbooks.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
**Operating Systems**

* Deep expertise in both Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu/CentOS) and Windows Server administration, including performance tuning and hardening.

**Networking & Security**

* Strong command of networking fundamentals, firewalls, forward and reverse proxies, and DMZ architecture design.
* Proven experience securing enterprise network environments and troubleshooting complex network issues.

**Automation & Scripting**

* Advanced, hands-on experience writing and architecting Terraform modules for multi-environment provisioning.
* Strong proficiency in Python for building automation frameworks and tooling, not just scripts.

**Containers & Orchestration**

* Deep, production-grade experience with Kubernetes — cluster architecture, scaling, troubleshooting, and operations at scale.
* Proven experience administering container registries, particularly Harbor, including governance and security integration.

**Cloud**

* Strong, hands-on Microsoft Azure expertise across compute, networking, storage, and identity, with experience designing cloud architecture.

**Security & Patching**

* Proven track record remediating OS kernel vulnerabilities at scale.
* Strong experience managing Java JDK patch/version lifecycles across environments.
* Experience building or improving vulnerability management/patch management processes.

**Leadership & Soft Skills**

* Proven ability to mentor junior engineers and lead technical initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder communication and ability to influence technical direction.
* Excellent documentation and process-ownership skills.
* Ability to work independently and drive projects from design through execution.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, CKA/CKAD, Terraform Associate, or equivalent.
* Experience in regulated, enterprise, or large-scale environments with strict compliance/security requirements.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps) and GitOps practices.
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.).
* Prior experience leading infrastructure migrations or cloud modernization projects.

**Experience Required**

* 8–12 years of relevant experience in infrastructure, DevOps, or cloud engineering, with at least 3+ years in a senior/lead capacity.

Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field required, or equivalent experience required. 4+ years of experience in systems engineering, systems administration, IT infrastructure, or a related field required. Demonstrates advanced capability in a primary technical area (e.g., Windows Server, Linux, VMware) with growing breadth across related domains (e.g., Cloud compute, network infrastructure). Strong structured analysis skills to independently troubleshoot and resolve complex enterprise system outages. Relevant industry certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator, Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA), VMware Certified Professional (VCP)) preferred.
  
  
******What Cencora offers******
Benefit offerings outside the US may vary by country and will be aligned to local market practice. The eligibility and effective date may differ for some benefits and for team members covered under collective bargaining agreements.
  
  
Full time

Full time

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)

Bachelor of Commerce/Business
  
  
**AWS Production & Payment Application Support - 6+ Yrs of Exp – 24/7 Rotational Shift – Pune Location**

At FIS we are looking for a Product Support Representative to join the FIS Enterprise Treasury Client Experience team. The successful candidate will provide treasury and payments production application support to our client base.

As an AWS Production Support Engineer, you will provide critical production application support for treasury and payments solutions used by global financial institutions and corporate clients. Success in this role requires strong technical troubleshooting skills, proactive problem-solving, and the ability to collaborate with global stakeholders while supporting a 24x7 operational environment.

* Provide production support for treasury and payments applications, ensuring high availability and operational excellence
* Support cloud-hosted environments across AWS and Azure, ensuring optimal application performance and stability
* You will be responsible for ensuring platform stability, incident resolution, service availability, and exceptional client experience across business-critical applications
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents, service disruptions, and client-reported issues within agreed service levels
* Monitor application performance, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions
* Manage incidents, service requests, and problem records using ticketing tools such as ServiceNow
* Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, cloud, and business teams to restore services and improve platform reliability

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of Hands-on experience with AWS cloud technologies and production support activities in cloud-based environments
* Experience supporting Java-based enterprise applications and containerized environments using Kubernetes
* Strong SQL skills with the ability to analyze data and troubleshoot application issues
* Experience in application production support, client services, or technical support roles within banking, treasury, payments, or financial services environments
* Strong understanding of financial operations, treasury workflows, and payment processing environments
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Windows and/or Linux operating systems administration and troubleshooting
* Experience using incident management and ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with proven client-facing experience

**What We Offer You**

* An opportunity to support global treasury clients using a leading FIS treasury solution
* Learning and career development across product support, treasury, technology, and client service
* Exposure to global clients and cross-functional teams

title: Senior Enterprise Software Engineer (Mandatory Skills - Python, Azure/AWS, Gen Ai)
description:
**Basic Function**
Wolters Kluwer is looking for a hands-on Lead Enterprise Cloud Software Developer in our Engineering Team to design, build, and integrate our next generation of enterprise cloud services. Leading and mentoring our Engineering team and collaborating closely with our customers, Design and Domain Architects, Cloud Operations, Security, Compliance, and other key stakeholders, the candidate will be responsible for driving key projects and initiatives in GBS.
  
  
Under moderate supervision, designs, develops, tests, debugs, and implements moderately complex software tools and utilities required for the operation, maintenance, and control of computer systems. Makes moderately complex modifications to existing software to fit specialized needs and configurations and maintains program libraries and technical documentation. Assists in planning, scheduling, and implementation. Initiates corrective action to stay on schedule.
  
  
Our Engineering team primarily focuses on designing and developing enterprise cloud services that automate traditional IT Operations tasks at scale using industry standards like infrastructure orchestration tools (such as Terraform), configuration management tools (like Ansible), Cloud software development kits (SDKs). Besides, the Engineering team is engaged in initiatives of transforming the IT Operations Services suite to be scalable and API-capable.
  
  
Our Lead Enterprise Cloud Software Developer will work closely with other Engineers leveraging a standard set of enterprise-wide artifacts such as Design Patterns and Standards, follow and establish guiding design principles ensuring the develop solutions or technical components deliver GBS strategic intent, while meeting the solution requirements providing business value.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Full-Stack Engineering (Python-first): Design and implement resilient services, APIs, and UIs with Python (FastAPI/Django/Flask) and modern front-end stacks (e.g., TypeScript/React) where needed; enforce clean architecture, SOLID principles, and comprehensive unit/integration tests.
* Cloud Programmability: Build automation and platform capabilities using Azure and AWS SDKs (e.g., azure-sdk-for-python, boto3), event-driven designs, serverless functions, and service APIs to standardize and accelerate cloud operations.
* AI for Developers: use AI assistants for code and test generation, defect pattern analysis, code optimization, and documentation; Integrate LLM-powered features safely; apply prompt engineering and evaluation; follow MLOps basics for model usage in applications.
* Infrastructure as Code & DevOps: Author Terraform modules and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps/GitLab) to deliver hands-free deployments, policy-as-code, and repeatable environments.
* Performance, Scalability, and Reliability: Profile and optimize code paths; apply caching, asynchronous I/O, connection pooling, efficient data models, and resource tuning; design for horizontal scale and graceful degradation; instrument services with APM/observability.
* Secure SDLC and Compliance: Practice threat modeling, secure coding, secret management, dependency hygiene, and code reviews; align with security champions and audit requirements.
* Quality Engineering: Define DoR/DoD, implement automated tests (unit, integration, performance, security), and continuously improve engineering practices.
* Architecture & Patterns: Apply industry-standard patterns (e.g., hexagonal architecture, CQRS where appropriate, pub/sub, idempotency) for reusability and maintainability; contribute to and consume enterprise design standards.
* Data & APIs: Design contract-first REST/GraphQL APIs; model relational and NoSQL data for correctness and performance; implement pagination, filtering, and rate-limiting.
* Collaboration & Documentation: Produce technical specifications, C4 model diagrams for C1–C3, and knowledge-base content; communicate status, risks, and trade-offs to stakeholders.
* Craft a culture of execution excellence coupled with innovation by incorporating best of the breed toolset
* Partner closely with Architecture and Engineering, Cloud Operations and Security teams to ensure the operationalization and adoption of engineering work.
* Mentor team members to adopt lateral thinking and “let me see how we can fix it” attitude.
* Guide fellow engineers and drive projects to completion by clarifying requirements, providing technical insights, and removing roadblocks.
* Report to stakeholders and leadership teams on the progress of key initiatives regularly
* Relentlessly document your implementation, patterns, practices, and processes.

**Breakdown:**
40% Software Development
  
  

* Develop, debug, and document enterprise grade applications & services using Azure and AWS SDKs, leveraging GenAI code assistants for authoring, validating, optimizing code
* Develop, Enhance, reverse engineer, and debug new/existing Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) capabilities leveraging tools such as Terraform, Ansible, etc.
* Explore new technologies, development patterns, and partake in pilots/POC/technology evaluations
* Participate in all aspects of the software development life cycle from design, delivery to on-going critical support
* Work to continually improve product functionality and quality
* Develop architecture, engineering and operational standards
* Deploy emergency bug fixes on services in production as required

30% Leadership
  
  

* Serve as a mentor to software developers and grow technical skills and practices for high-quality software development
* Lead team members in solving complex technical problems and using sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgement and identify innovative solutions
* Work independently, with moderate guidance in only the most complex situations and leading teams or projects with moderate resource requirements, risk, and/or complexity

20% Software Design/Troubleshooting
  
  

* Contribute to software design and architecture
* Coordinate and assist in complex troubleshooting
* Performing peer reviews

10% New Technologies
  
  

* Actively explore new trends and identifying new ways of solving old problems, leveraging GenAI solutions approved by WK AI COE.

**What You Bring To The Team**

* Passion and Energy to work in a team to turn a vision into a reality
* Empower the team to understand and be comfortable with failing fast and learning from failures to fully realize and maximize innovative spirit of the team.
* Establish decisive decision making utilizing strategic thinking and guidance from stakeholders and teams utilizing and supporting services.
* Establish strong focus on ensuring services can be effectively ran by operations.
* Customer-focused mindset – Drive the team to work together to solve real problems for our customers and users.
* A strong focus on the details, by coaching and influencing the team to pay attention to the details.
* Have an eye for how to market the services properly and effectively to our customers and other key stakeholders.
* Bring focus on identifying, building, and effectively tracking efficiencies, via metrics, for enterprise services.

**Other Duties**

* Performs other duties as assigned by management

**Job Qualifications & EXPERIENCE**
**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field or equivalent experience
* Required: Advanced/Professional Technical Certificate in Azure, AWS or Kubernetes

**Experience:**

* Minimum 6 years of experience in enterprise software development and cloud development:

+ Experience with FastAPI/Django, React/TypeScript, and GraphQL.
+ Knowledge of event-driven architectures (e.g., SNS/SQS, Azure Service Bus), streaming (Kafka/Kinesis), and pub/sub patterns.
+ Familiarity with APM tools and SLO/SLA design; capacity and performance testing at scale.
+ Exposure to AI/ML services (e.g., Azure OpenAI) and safe LLM integration patterns.
+ Contributions to shared Terraform modules and internal design standards.
+ Experience with automated deployments utilizing continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) tools (such as Azure DevOps, GitLab, GitHub, Jenkins or other well-known tools)
+ Experience with release management, product rollouts, and service operationalization
+ Solid and proven experience with design patterns, SOLID Principles, especially cloud resiliency patterns, working in an agile environment with an SDLC like Scrum, SaFE, etc.
+ Being able to write scalable production-grade code leveraging Cloud software development kit (SDKs) and Cloud APIs in (at least) one of the following programming languages: Python, Java, NodeJS or Ruby

* Advanced Technology Adoption and Utilization:

+ AI Tool Proficiency: Evaluate and optimize AI tool usage for team efficiency and productivity
+ AI Output Validation: Establish validation standards and review processes for AI-generated code
+ Responsible AI Usage: Lead responsible AI initiatives and establish team best practices
+ Agentic Workflow Design: Design and optimize AI agent workflows for team efficiency

* Having a wide range of experiences and advanced technical acumen serving as an advisor to management
* Communicating difficult concepts and influencing others to adopt a different point of view
* Enthusiasm for staying abreast of industry trends and a keen eye for product improvements

**Soft Skills:**

* Team working
* A logical approach to work
* The ability to prioritize tasks/organize work
* Excellent oral, written and interpersonal English communication skills including strong presentation skills.
* Availability to work on extra time
* Problem-solving skills
* Patience
* Meticulous attention to details

**Travel REquirements**
Position requires occasional travel on a domestic and international travel
  
  
**Physical Demands**
Normal professional office environment:
  
  

* Hybrid: In-person with Wolters Kluwer colleagues at least 8 days per month

title: Associate Technical Architect (DE - GCP)
description:
The purpose of this role is to create solution architectures for systems and platforms ensuring all relevant options are explored for time, cost and compliance to the company’s standards, policies and practices whilst meeting the business’ requirements. The role will oversee the work of other architects and delivery of the solution for clients both internal and external, shepherding it through the relevant governance.
  
  
**Job Description:**
We are looking for a highly skilled GCP Data Engineer with strong programming fundamentals and cloud-native architecture experience. The candidate should have hands-on expertise in building scalable data pipelines on Google Cloud Platform, integrating external APIs, and applying software engineering principles to data workflows.
  
  
**Business Title**
Associate Technical Architect
  
  
**Years Of Experience**
10+ Years
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, Design and build Cloud solutions using GCP.
* Design and implement modular, object-oriented Python applications for data ingestion and transformation.
* Strong Object-Oriented Programming skills. Proficient in designing and implementing scalable, maintainable data pipelines using core OOP principles such as encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, and abstraction. Experienced in building modular systems with well-defined class hierarchies, applying SOLID principles to ensure clean architecture and separation of concerns. Skilled in leveraging design patterns to solve complex problems and enhance code readability and testability.
* Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using GCP services: BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Cloud Composer, and DataForm.
* Integrate with external APIs to extract and load data into BigQuery.
* Develop event-driven architectures using Pub/Sub and Eventarc to trigger workflows and manage real-time data streams.
* Automate deployment and testing workflows using Cloud Build and CI/CD pipelines.
* Optimize performance and cost of data processing and storage across GCP services.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.
* Ensure data security, governance, and compliance across all pipelines and storage layers.

**Must Have Skills**

* 10 years of experience in data engineering, with at least 4+ years on Google Cloud Platform.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Platform Architect, focusing on Infrastructure area to shape, govern, and drive the infrastructure architecture for our AI Platform across multi-cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, Alibaba Cloud) and on‑prem environments. This role sets the infrastructure direction for onboarding new platform capabilities, ensuring alignment to HSBC enterprise architecture, security, and operational standards, and providing clear technical leadership to infrastructure engineering teams to execute.
  
  
You’ll act as a trusted infrastructure consultant to engineering, product, and control functions—translating AI platform needs into pragmatic, supportable infrastructure designs that are secure, scalable, resilient, and compliant.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
'1. Define and govern infrastructure architecture for the AI Platform: reference architectures, standards, guardrails, patterns and roadmaps across cloud and also on‑prem environments.
  
  

* Provide technical direction and design authority for infrastructure engineering teams, including solution reviews, design approvals, and delivery oversight.
* Lead vendor/product evaluation and adoption (e.g. GPU platforms, Kubernetes distributions, storage and networking solutions, observability stacks), ensuring fit with HSBC infrastructure requirements, support models, and lifecycle management.
* Partner closely with HSBC platform and infrastructure team on on‑prem platform development, integration with existing data center capabilities, and operational readiness.
* Design and guide implementation of GPU infrastructure for AI/ML workloads (capacity planning, scheduling, tenancy/isolation, performance, reliability, cost controls).
* Embed security, compliance, and operational controls by design, working with Cyber Security, Data, Model Risk Management (MRM), and other stakeholders (e.g., identity, encryption, logging, vulnerability management, auditability).
* Ensure production-grade non-functionals: availability, disaster recovery, monitoring/alerting, SLOs, incident readiness, and automation (IaC, CI/CD enablement where relevant).

**What We're Looking For**
'1. Proven infrastructure architecture leadership for large-scale platforms, including defining reference architectures, standards, guardrails, and roadmaps across cloud and on‑prem.
  
  

* Proven ability to produce clear, practical infrastructure designs that translate business and technical requirements into secure, scalable, reusable and maintainable platform solutions.
* Hands-on experience building and delivering platform capabilities across both cloud and on-premises environments, with a strong understanding of production engineering and operational considerations.
* Good knowledge of one or more major cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or Alibaba Cloud, including core services, networking, identity, and security principles.
* Experience with modern platform engineering practices, including APIs, containerisation, Kubernetes, CI/CD, automation, and observability.
* Familiarity with infrastructure as code, policy as code, and reusable platform patterns.
* Experience evaluating and adopting vendor products/services (e.g., Kubernetes distributions, GPU solutions, observability tooling) and aligning them to enterprise support, lifecycle, and operational models.
* Strong stakeholder management skills: able to build trusted relationships with engineering, product, and control functions; translate complex requirements into pragmatic infrastructure designs.

**What additional skills will be good to have?**

* Good understanding of Agent, skill and MCP processing patterns, including deployment architecture, runtime operations, performance, and reliability considerations
* Familiarity with FinOps / cost optimisation approaches for platform infrastructure, especially for GPU and high-throughput data workloads
* Knowledge of service management and reliability practices (problem management, root-cause analysis, continuous service improvement, post-incident actions aligned to NFRs/SLOs).
* Knowledge of GPU ecosystem (e.g., scheduling strategies, partitioning, performance tuning, capacity management, and cost governance for accelerated compute).
* Experience defining platform architecture principles, standards, and target-state roadmaps to guide consistent design and delivery

You’ll achieve more at HSBC
  
  
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

description:
**Summary**

**you’ll do:**

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, engineering, math or equivalent.

title: Senior Enterprise Technology Engineer
description:
**Entity**
Technology
  
  
**Job Family Group**
IT&S Group
  
  
**Job Description**
**You will work with**
You will lead a high-energy, top-performing team of engineers and product managers, working alongside technology and business leaders to shape the vision and drive the execution of progressive platform initiatives that make a real impact.
  
  
**Let Me Tell You About The Role**
The Senior Enterprise Technology Engineer provides engineering leadership across bp's digital landscape, connecting squads with bp's platforms and engineering capabilities to deliver high-quality, scalable, and resilient solutions aligned to business strategy. They lead end-to-end technical delivery, ensure engineering integrity at scale, and actively manage delivery and technical risk while guiding teams through complex build challenges.
  
  
Operating as a hands-on technical leader with strong customer and stakeholder influence, they balance long-term engineering excellence with near-term delivery outcomes, empowering squads to make sound technical decisions and fostering a unified, pragmatic, and sustainable engineering culture across bp.
  
  
This role will play a key leadership position in delivering modern B2B customer portal and commerce capabilities, working closely with customer engagement platforms, product teams, architecture teams, SAP teams, and engineering squads to maximise reuse of shared platform capabilities and accelerate delivery through modern composable architecture principles.
  
  
**What You Will Deliver**
**Technology**
Leads a team of enterprise engineers to design, develop, and deliver high-quality platforms and services. Acts as a hands-on technical authority on bp's platforms, languages, and frameworks, including Node.js, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, cloud-native architectures, and enterprise integration patterns. Drives squad goals, prioritises initiatives, and delivers in a product-led, empowered environment. Guides modernisation of legacy estates to unlock future capabilities.
  
  
**Delivery & Transformation**
Owns end-to-end delivery of complex B2B commerce and customer portal transformation programmes, from discovery through build, migration, cutover, and hypercare. Manages delivery risk, sequencing, and dependencies across squads, vendors, and SI partners. Ensures legacy-to-modern transitions are planned for coexistence, data migration, and minimal business disruption.
  
  
Drives adoption of MACH and composable architecture principles, ensuring alignment with strategic customer engagement platforms through reuse of shared capabilities, APIs, services, and design patterns.
  
  
**Data**
Engineers data-intensive solutions and integration flows across enterprise systems. Builds secure, governed, and interoperable data pipelines with strong quality, lineage, and observability. Designs and governs API-led and event-driven integration architectures using REST, GraphQL, OData, SAP integration patterns, and enterprise messaging solutions.
  
  
**Commercial Awareness**
Applies engineering insight to cost and value priorities, including cloud spend and TCO. Evaluates tools and platforms for fit, resilience, and lock-in risk to inform build-vs-buy decisions.
  
  
**Safety, Security & Compliance**
Embeds secure-by-design practices and supports audit, licensing, and compliance obligations as part of routine delivery.
  
  
**Collaboration & Influence**
Acts as a technical expert, providing guidance and support to the squad and wider engineering community. Communicates clearly with team members, partners, and customers. Represents engineering in governance and design forums to resolve technical trade-offs.
  
  
Leads and governs delivery partners, system integrators, and product vendors, ensuring architectural and engineering standards are upheld across the extended delivery ecosystem.
  
  
Works closely with Product, UX, Architecture, SAP, Integration, and Platform teams to ensure solutions align with strategic platform roadmaps and maximise reuse of common capabilities and technical assets.
  
  
**Building Teams**
Shapes squad structures, tech-lead roles, and engineering capacity for complex programmes. Develop an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture through technical leadership and collaboration.
  
  
**Growing People**
Mentors engineers across grades and supports succession planning. Promotes standard methodologies, maintainable code, clear documentation, and high-quality work.
  
  
**Change Leadership**
Leads engineering transformation and adoption of modern practices, including DevSecOps, SRE, platform engineering, cloud-native delivery, composable architecture, and AI-assisted development. Ensures quality in enterprise platform engineering at the squad level and owns the engineering narrative for change.
  
  
**Technical Skills**
**What you will need to be successful**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 12+ years of experience in enterprise technology, security, and operations in large-scale global environments, with 4+ years in a technical leadership role delivering cloud-native, MACH (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless), composable architecture, and customer-facing digital platform solutions.
* Strong experience building, leading, and running high-performance engineering teams, with a focus on reliability, automation, operational excellence, and customer success.
* Deep knowledge of ITIL, Agile, DevSecOps, and enterprise technology governance frameworks.
* Hands-on software engineering experience, including test driven development, automated testing, CI/CD, code quality management, and modern engineering practices.
* Strong understanding of B2B commerce and customer portal capabilities, including Product Catalog Management, Product Modelling, Inventory Availability, Shopping Cart and Checkout, Order Management, Search and Browse, SEO, and Personalisation.
* Strong experience integrating customer engagement and commerce platforms with SAP ERP/S/4HANA using IDoc, BAPI, OData, RFC, SAP CPI/BTP, APIs, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Strong technical expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, JavaScript, relational databases, microservices, BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) patterns, API orchestration, API gateways, and modern distributed system design.
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering modern web applications using React, reusable component architectures, responsive design, GraphQL, and headless front-end architectures.
* Experience delivering cloud-native applications on Azure and/or AWS using containers, Kubernetes, managed services, infrastructure automation, observability, and DevSecOps pipelines.
* Experience implementing enterprise security solutions including OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), Azure AD, SSO, and role-based access control.
* Experience working with Git-based source control, modern software delivery practices, and engineering lifecycle management.
* Experience leading delivery through vendor and SI partner ecosystems, holding partners accountable for engineering quality, timelines, architecture compliance, and delivery outcomes.
* Experience designing and delivering global, multi-country, multi-currency, and multi-language B2B commerce and customer portal solutions.
* Experience within the Energy, Oil & Gas, or other complex enterprise industries is an advantage.

**Essential Skills**

* Deep expertise in designing, building, and operating highly available, scalable, and resilient distributed systems.
* Strong experience delivering B2B customer portals and commerce solutions using MACH (Microservices, API-First, Cloud-Native, Headless) and composable architecture principles.
* Deep technical expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, API-led integration, and event-driven architectures within large-scale enterprise environments.
* Experience integrating enterprise platforms with SAP ERP/S/4HANA and other business-critical systems using modern integration patterns.
* Hands-on experience with cloud-native delivery on Azure and/or AWS, including infrastructure automation, CI/CD, observability, operational readiness, and lifecycle ownership.
* Proven experience in reliability engineering, incident management, disaster recovery, application performance monitoring, and operational excellence for business-critical platforms.
* Experience delivering solutions spanning custom-built software, configured platforms, and third-party integrations at enterprise scale.
* Experience establishing engineering standards, architecture governance, reusable platform capabilities, and engineering best practices across multiple squads.
* Strong ability to resolve technical trade-offs across squads, platforms, vendors, and stakeholders while balancing delivery, architecture, and business priorities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business and delivery outcomes.
* Experience collaborating across Product, UX, Architecture, Platform Engineering, SAP, and business teams to deliver customerfocused solutions.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience delivering omnichannel B2B journeys spanning portal, mobile, CSR-assisted, and partner channels.
* Familiarity with CDP, CRM, and customer experience platforms (e.g., Salesforce, SAP Qualtrics) and related integrations.
* Experience delivering modern solutions leveraging AI-enabled capabilities, including AI/ML platforms, agentic architectures, and enterprise AI integration.
* Experience building reusable design systems, shared component libraries, and platform-based customer experiences.
* Experience working on large-scale customer engagement platforms and digital transformation programmes leveraging Node.js, React, GraphQL, SAP integration, and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience in regulated industries such as Energy, Oil & Gas, Industrial, or other highly governed enterprise environments

title: Cyber- DT&P- Infrastructure - AI Security Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
AI Security Consultant, Infrastructure
  
  
As an AI Security Consultant specializing in Infrastructure in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own technical workstreams that secure the cloud, network, container and model-serving foundations used to run generative AI and agentic workloads. You will combine client advisory with hands-on engineering, turning requirements into architectures, integrations and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations and help estimate delivery work.
  
  
Work you'll do
  
  
As an AI Security Consultant on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for
  
  

* Build secure AI landing-zone components across cloud accounts or subscriptions, networks, identity, compute, Kubernetes, model services and observability.
* Design and deploy secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Kubernetes-based platforms.
* Lead implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets, artifact controls, IaC and policy enforcement.
* Engineer and review Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience and controlled enterprise integration.
* Plan and execute platform security, resilience and operational testing, diagnose complex failures, and drive issues through resolution.
* Own an infrastructure workstream, manage dependencies and milestones, and provide day-to-day guidance to consultants.
* Lead technical demonstrations and prototypes, and contribute architecture, effort and estimation inputs to pursuits.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

description:
**Company Description**
**NEC Software Solutions (India)**
On 1st July 2021, Rave Technologies became NEC Software Solutions India. This change brought us under the global NEC Corporation brand. We are proud to be part of an organisation with 122 years of experience in evolution with technology and innovation.
  
  
We have more than 30 years of experience in providing end to end IT services across the globe and have earned a reputation for delighting our customers by consistently surpassing expectations and helping them deliver robust, market-ready software products that meet the highest standards of engineering and user experience. Supported by more than 1300 exceptionally talented manpower, we are a hub for offshore support and technology services.
  
  
We work with diverse industry verticals which include publishing, media, financial services, retail, healthcare and technology companies around the world. Our customers range from two-person startups to $bn listed companies.
  
  
For more information, visit at www.necsws.com/india.
  
  
**About NEC Corporation**
NEC Corporation is a Japanese multinational information technology and electronics company, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It is recognised as a ‘Top 50 Innovative Company’ globally and the NEC Group globally provides “Solutions for Society” that promote the safety, security, fairness and equality of society. Their main goal is to help create a safer society with their innovations in technologies.
  
  
NEC Corporation has established itself as a leader in the integration of IT and network technologies while promoting the brand statement of “Orchestrating a brighter world.” NEC enables businesses and communities to adapt to rapid changes taking place in both society and the market as it provides for the social values of safety, security, fairness and efficiency to promote a more sustainable world where everyone has the chance to reach their full potential.
  
  
For more information, visit NEC at https://www.nec.com.
  
  
**Job Description**
**You will be responsible for:-**

* Monitor and maintain Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Azure SQL Database environments.
* Ensure database availability, performance, reliability, and security.
* Perform database performance tuning and optimize SQL queries, indexes, stored procedures, and database objects to improve application performance.
* Troubleshoot database-related incidents and ensure timely resolution.
* Support application teams in resolving database performance and connectivity issues.
* Manage database users, roles, permissions, and access requests.
* Implement and maintain database security standards and compliance requirements.
* Investigate and resolve blocking, deadlocks, long-running queries, and locking issues.
* Participate in Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
* Support application and development teams in resolving database-related issues and performance concerns.
* Implement and manage Azure SQL High Availability and Disaster Recovery (HA/DR) solutions, including Failover Groups (FOG), Geo-Replication, Backup & Recovery,

and performance monitoring across Azure SQL environments.
  
  
**Required Technical Skills: -**

* B. Tech/MCA or equivalent qualification.
* 3-5 years of hands-on Database Administration experience.
* Strong experience with:

+ Microsoft SQL Server (Mandatory)
+ MySQL
+ PostgreSQL
+ Azure SQL Database / Azure SQL Managed Instance (Mandatory)

* Strong knowledge of:

+ SQL Query Writing (Mandatory)
+ SQL, T-SQL, MySQL SQL, and PostgreSQL SQL
+ Query Performance Tuning and Query Optimization
+ Stored Procedures, Functions, Views, and Triggers
+ Index Management and Execution Plan Analysis
+ Database Security and User Management
+ Database Monitoring and Troubleshooting
+ Blocking, Deadlock, and Long-Running Query Analysis

* Azure Database Skills:

+ Azure SQL Database Administration and Managed Instance
+ Azure SQL Failover Groups (FOG).
+ Azure Monitor and Performance Monitoring Tools
+ Familiarity with Azure database environments and monitoring tools.
+ Familiarity with programming languages like Java
+ Strong problem-solving skills and ability to think analytically.

* Good to Have Skill:

+ MongoDB / NoSQL Databases
+ Liquibase
+ PostgreSQL

**Required Soft Skill: -**

* Have the ability to work in teams and take instruction from a variety of people.
* Polite and approachable manners when liaising with people both internally and externally.
* Show a willingness to listen and learn.
* Take initiative in self-development and career progression.
* Good communication skills.
* Be punctual and reliable.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and take seriously the responsibility for delivering these tasks on time and to a high quality.
* Demonstrate an ability to alleviate pressure and stress through prioritizing work, time management, and sound organizational skills.

**Qualifications**
Graduate
  
  
**Additional Information**
Good Communication Skills required.

description:

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

description:

**The Opportunity**
Are you a seasoned professional with strong hands-on expertise in virtualization, SDN, and network security, complemented by excellent consulting and communication skills? The Staff Consulting Architect will be a vital member of Nutanix's Professional Services team, which is dedicated to delivering innovative virtualization, software-defined networking (SDN), and network security solutions to our clients. This team operates from Bangalore or Pune and fosters a collaborative and inclusive culture that values creativity and knowledge sharing. The mission of the team is to empower organizations with next-generation data center and hybrid cloud environments that enhance performance, security, and scalability.
  
  
You will report to the Director of Professional Services, who promotes a supportive and mentoring leadership style, focusing on empowering team members to achieve their full potential and encouraging a strong sense of collaboration. The role is hybrid, requiring the employee to come into the office three days a week, fostering teamwork and facilitating knowledge exchange while allowing flexibility for remote work.
  
  
Nutanix is seeking a
**Staff Consulting Architect**
specializing in
**virtualization, software-defined networking (SDN), and network security**
to design, implement, and optimize next-generation data centre and hybrid cloud environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess
**strong hands-on expertise in hypervisors (VMware / AHV)**
and a

+ Virtual networks, overlays (Geneve / VXLAN), logical switches and routers.

* Enable L2 extensions, VPN tunnels, and BGP sessions across sites or clouds.
* Implement application-centric security and isolation policies for East-West and North-South traffic control.
* Support workload and network migrations between virtualization platforms with minimal downtime.
* Integrate network visibility and flow analytics into compliance systems.
